summary.text: Josh Burbrink is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 59 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Ryan Lauer. He works as a business intelligence analyst.

paragraphs.text: Josh Burbrink graduated from Columbus East High School and earned an associate degree from ITT Technical Institute in 2006.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Bartholomew County, lives in Harrison Township on a small hobby farm with his wife, a librarian at the Bartholomew County Public Library, and their young daughter, and sits on the Harrison Township Volunteer Fire Company board.
Burbrink listed protecting public schools, libraries and fire departments as his key campaign messages, citing property tax changes passed by the General Assembly.
He also named reproductive rights, public health funding, immigration-enforcement legislation and environmental quality among the policy areas he cares about.
